title: Live app
text:
The interactive app is hosted on shinyapps.io. It loads the precomputed DSM, shading map and ERA5 meteorology from its bundled cache, so pressing Run calculation recomputes yield for all seven surfaces in seconds.
Change the panel count, mounting height, aspect or slope for any surface and re-run to see the effect on annual, monthly and diurnal yield. Note that changing a height requires re-simulating the shading map, which is slower.






If the embedded frame does not load, open the app directly.

title: GBsolar
text:
The Bunbury site
Seven roof surfaces at Bunbury (53.114°N, −2.646°E) are assessed, totalling 63 panels. All the expensive inputs — the LiDAR DSM, terrain derivatives, monthly shading maps and the ERA5 time series — are precomputed once, so the interactive app recalculates yield for every surface in seconds when you change panel counts or orientation.



Surfaces assessed
7 (63 panels)


Total estimated yield
~9,300 kWh/year (5-yr mean)


Shading
LiDAR DSM, monthly shadow maps


Meteorology
ERA5 single-levels + ERA5-Land

title: Analysis
Analysis
text:
Method
Direct radiation is attenuated by the LiDAR-derived shading fraction per month and hour, then combined with isotropic diffuse and ground-reflected radiation on the tilted plane. Cell temperature derating follows the NOCT model; panel area and efficiency defaults are 1.6 m² and 15.3%. Surfaces without a user-specified aspect or slope take their values from the DSM terrain derivatives at the surface point.
